decision_rationale: at least one mirrored comparison improves by 1%, but the strong mirrored/repeatability rule is not met

decision_rule.A: both mirrors improve TPOT p99 or total energy by at least 3%, exceed run variability, avoid material regressions, and H/H control is within 3%
decision_rule.B: at least one mirror improves TPOT p99 or total energy by at least 1% without material regressions, but A is not met
